sources.title: Keras Lambda Layer Serialization Error Fix Guide
sources.snippet: Model serialization in TensorFlow can surface unexpected NameErrors when using Lambda layers to wrap external dependencies like TF Hub components. Learn why this occurs in production ML pipelines and how to properly structure your Keras Sequential models for flawless deployment and enterprise inference.

sources.title: Model Serialization Attacks | protectai/modelscan | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This document provides a comprehensive explanation of model serialization attacks in machine learning systems, their potential impacts, and how the ModelScan tool helps detect them. It covers the mechanisms behind these attacks, the vulnerable serialization formats, and best practices for secure model handling.

sources.snippet: Layerfault examines models--* repositories and their refs, snapshots and blobs, validates that snapshot symlinks resolve inside the repository blob store, identifies broken refs/detached snapshots/orphan blobs, and structurally inspects supported model artifacts.
